# Pickleball repository instructions

Read and follow `/AGENTS.md` for every repository task.

For functionality changes, consult `/docs/agent/feature-map.md`, then inspect and update every affected implementation, framework test, Maven consumer scenario, service definition, local test-site resource, configuration example, and documentation page.

Use Java 21 and run the validation specified in `/AGENTS.md`. Preserve existing consumer behavior unless a breaking change is explicitly requested. Do not require the user to restate repository background already documented in the project.
